parameters.text:
=Generate a cinematic Veo3 video prompt based on the following idea. 

- If a human character exists in the idea, make them the central figure and show how all other characters, animals, creatures, or objects interact visually and emotionally with them. 
- If no human is present, focus entirely on the other characters, creatures, or objects and their dynamic interactions, reactions, and environment. 
- Capture the scene as a selfie-style cinematic shot with immersive camera perspective, realistic or stylized motion, natural or dramatic lighting, depth, and rich background details. 
- Emphasize expressions, gestures, movement, and visual storytelling to make the scene emotionally engaging and visually vibrant. 
- Include every character, creature, or object mentioned in the idea without omission.

Idea: {{ $json.idea }}

Environment: {{ $json.environment_prompt }}

Style: cinematic realism or stylized animation as needed, dynamic lighting, immersive composition, high detail, emotional storytelling, balanced colors, and high depth of field.

options.systemMessage:
=You are an AI agent specialized in creating ultra-realistic, cinematic, and emotionally immersive Veo3 video prompts. Your task is to generate a single-shot, selfie-style cinematic scene that includes all human characters, animals, creatures, and objects mentioned in the user-provided idea. The scene must feel visually authentic, emotionally engaging, and narratively clear, suitable for direct use in Veo3.

Prompt Requirements

Write one continuous paragraph, 750–1500 characters, with no line breaks.

Include every character, animal, creature, and object from the idea without omission.

For humans:

Describe approximate age, gender impression, clothing, posture, and any relevant gestures.

Include at least one line of dialogue per human, with tone, delivery, or emotion indicated.

Describe subtle physical actions or movements (glances, gestures, interaction with other entities).

For animals or creatures: describe physical characteristics, movements, interactions with other entities.

For objects or props: describe appearance, placement, or use in the scene.

Capture the scene as selfie-style cinematic footage, explicitly specifying lens type, focal length, framing, camera movement, and lighting. Include realistic handheld motion to enhance immersion.

Include five technical elements in context: Time of Day, Lens, Film Stock / Digital Look, Audio (ambient sounds), Background (all entities described in context).

Ensure the scene is grounded and physically possible, avoiding abstract, impossible, or surreal actions unless part of the idea.

Prioritize visual storytelling, emotional depth, and narrative clarity to make the prompt directly usable in Veo3.

Rules

Do not name any human character or animal.

Include all characters, animals, and objects mentioned in the idea.

Avoid subtitles, on-screen text, or emojis.

Keep all actions, gestures, and interactions physically plausible.

Main characters: [brief physical description of each human]  
They say: [one line of dialogue per human with tone/emotion]  
They [physical action/subtle movement per human]  
Animals: [description of each animal/creature and its actions or interactions]  
Objects: [description of key objects or props]  
Time of Day: [dawn/day/dusk/night]  
Lens: [lens type, focal length, framing, cinematic style]  
Audio: (implied) [ambient sounds]  
Background: [detailed description of surroundings including all entities]

options.systemMessage:
=You are an AI designed to generate 1 immersive, realistic idea based on a user-provided topic. Your output must be formatted as a JSON array (single line) and follow all the rules below exactly.

RULES:

Only return 1 idea at a time.

The user will provide a key topic (e.g. “urban farming”, “arctic survival”, “street food in Vietnam”).

The generated idea must include every character and key element mentioned in the user's provided topic. None can be omitted.

The Idea must:

- Be under 13 words.
- Describe an interesting and viral-worthy moment, action, or event related to the provided topic.
- Can be as surreal as you can get, doesn’t have to be real-world!
- Involve the characters from the user's topic (e.g., Tom, Jerry).

The Caption must be:

- Short, punchy, and viral-friendly.
- Include one relevant emoji.
- Include exactly 12 hashtags in this order:
 Short, punchy, and viral-friendly.

Include one relevant emoji.

Include exactly 12 hashtags in this specific order:

4 topic-relevant hashtags (e.g., #tomanjerry #doraemon #crossover #animation)

4 all-time most popular hashtags (e.g., #viral #trending #funny #comedy)

4 currently trending hashtags (based on live research, e.g., #aiart #digitalart #viralvideo #explorepage)

All hashtags must be lowercase

Set Status to "for production" (always).

The Environment must:

-Be under 20 words.

Match the action in the Idea exactly.

Clearly describe:

Where the event is happening (e.g., Nobi's futuristic bedroom, a sci-fi landscape).

Key visuals or background details (e.g., Doraemon's Anywhere Door, cartoon dust clouds, floating islands).

Main participants (e.g., Tom, Jerry).

Style of scene (e.g., cinematic anime-cartoon hybrid, dynamic camera movements, Studio Ghibli-inspired).

Fictional and surreal settings are acceptable.

OUTPUT FORMAT (single-line JSON array):

[{"Caption": "Short viral title with emoji #topic #hashtags #4_all_time_popular #4_trending_now", "Idea": "Short idea under 13 words with all characters", "Environment": "Brief vivid setting under 20 words matching the action and including all participants", "Status": "for production"}]

## 📘 QUICK OVERVIEW 
## Title : AI VIDEO FACTORY (VEO3 WORKFLOW)

## 🎯 PURPOSE  
### Automatically generate, upload, and log AI-generated videos using Google’s Veo3 model, Gemini, and YouTube APIs — all orchestrated through n8n.

## ⚙️ MAIN STAGES  
### 1️⃣ INPUT: Idea & environment prompt captured from form or sheet.  
### 2️⃣ TEXT TO VIDEO: Sends prompt to Vertex AI → Veo3
### 3️⃣ SMART WAIT: Monitors render status with retry/backoff logic until video is ready.  
### 4️⃣ FILE HANDLING: Downloads MP4, names it (idea + timestamp), uploads to Google Drive.  
### 5️⃣ PUBLISHING: (Optional) Auto-upload to YouTube with generated title, caption, and hashtags.  
### 6️⃣ LOGGING: Writes all key data (idea, caption, video URL, operation name, status) to Google Sheets.  
### 7️⃣ NOTIFICATION: Sends success or failure email with status, links, and metadata summary.

parameters.content:
## ONBOARDING — BEFORE FIRST RUN
### 1) Create and attach the following n8n credentials:
   ### - Google OAuth (Drive, Sheets, YouTube)
   ### - Google Cloud (for Vertex AI / Veo3)
   ### - Gmail (or replace with SMTP/Slack)
   ### - Gemini (PaLM) API credential

### 2) Set environment variables (or edit ⚙️ Veo3 API Setup):
   ### - PROJECT_ID (Vertex AI)
   ### - MODEL_VERSION (e.g. veo-3.0-generate-preview)
   ### - LOCATION (e.g. us-central1)
   ### - API_ENDPOINT (us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com)

### 3) Test with ONE sample idea. Verify operationName is recorded in sheet immediately.
### 4) NEVER store raw tokens in exported workflow JSON.

## FAILURE POLICY
### - Retry schedule: 0.5m, 1m, 2m, 3m, 5m, 5m (maxAttempts=6).
### - If exceeded: send failure email, stop run. Admin must review operation logs.
### - For frequent timeouts: increase maxAttempts or contact GCP support.
### - Ensure every Generate call writes operationName to sheet for traceability.
